title: TradeWar: A Benchmark for Execution-Grounded Trade Negotiation with Adaptive LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.42004v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn negotiation remains a challenging problem for large language model (LLM) agents. While LLMs can conduct natural-language dialogue, existing benchmarks predominantly assess only agreement rates, overlooking whether negotiated commitments actually create value once executed. To address this gap, we introduce TradeWar, a multi-country simulation benchmark that translates negotiation dialogues into concrete tariff and trade-share policies, enforces capacity and network constraints during settlement, and evaluates outcomes via an Economic Health Index (EHI). To solve this execution-grounded task, we propose TACTIC (Trade-aware Adaptive Consolidation and Theory-of-mind for International Commerce), an agent that iteratively refines its negotiation strategy across episodes-without updating base LLM weights-by leveraging prior experience, opponent behavior, and past settlement outcomes. translated_title: TradeWar：一个基于执行效果的自适应LLM智能体贸易谈判基准
translated_abstract: 多轮谈判对大语言模型（LLM）智能体而言仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。虽然LLM能够进行自然语言对话，但现有基准主要只评估达成协议的比率，忽视了谈判达成的承诺在执行后是否真正创造价值。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了TradeWar，这是一个多国模拟基准，它将谈判对话转化为具体的关税和贸易份额政策，在结算过程中强制执行产能和网络约束，并通过经济健康指数（EHI）来评估结果。为了解决这一以执行效果为基础的任务，我们提出了TACTIC（面向国际贸易的贸易感知自适应整合与心智理论方法），这是一种智能体，它能够在不更新基础LLM权重的情况下，通过利用先验经验、对手行为和过去的结算结果，在多轮次的模拟中迭代地优化其谈判策略。尽管使用零样本思维链提示……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出了TradeWar多国贸易谈判模拟基准和TACTIC自适应智能体，通过将谈判对话转化为具体关税政策、强制执行产能与网络约束并以经济健康指数评估结果，使LLM智能体能够在不更新模型权重的情况下从历史经验和对手行为中迭代优化谈判策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TradeWar, a multi-country simulation benchmark that grounds trade negotiations in executable tariff policies evaluated by an Economic Health Index, together with TACTIC, an adaptive LLM agent that iteratively refines its negotiation strategy across episodes without updating base model weights.
